request.prompt:
EDIT MODE ONLY. Create exactly one revised high-resolution full-body source frame for SABLE CIRCUIT SITE-7 rifle trooper, slot S/walk/0, by editing image 1 as the appearance and native-alpha authority. Image 1 is the only appearance reference: preserve its exact Rook identity, full body, hooded dark tactical suit, weathered silver/red body armor, backpack/radio, boots, single anatomical-right thigh holster, gloves, face/visor, and bullpup rifle. Do not replace, redesign, or mix the character with any other character. Image 2 is only a camera and LOWER-LEG POSE/CONTACT guide; ignore image 2's mannequin appearance, arms, hands, torso, costume, and weapon completely.

Apply the S/walk/0 left_contact pose to the preserved image-1 character with a straight front camera and exactly two anatomically connected legs. Anatomical LEFT leg must be the forward planted contact leg on viewer-right. The holster-bearing anatomical RIGHT leg must trail behind on viewer-left. Do not reverse the legs and do not add any third knee, shin, calf, foot, duplicate limb, fused or detached boot.

Correct the upper body while preserving the image-1 appearance: torso faces directly toward camera; rifle is actively shouldered and aimed straight forward toward camera; buttstock seated at the character's RIGHT shoulder (viewer-left); right hand is on the trigger grip; left hand supports the fore-end; a short foreshortened front muzzle/barrel opening is visibly aimed toward camera. Never muzzle-down, never vertical carry, never hanging toward the thigh, never side-profile carry. Keep both hands anatomically attached to the same rifle and keep the hood, face, armor, holster, boots, hair/garment edges, and weapon silhouette coherent.

The output must be an actual native RGBA PNG: background pixels alpha 0, subject visible pixels alpha 1..254, solid interior pixels alpha 254, and no alpha 255 anywhere. Preserve the native alpha exactly; do not flatten, clamp, key, redraw, composite, or paint a substitute background. Absolutely no green/chroma, checkerboard, backdrop, matte, floor, cast shadow, glow, halo, reflection, scenery, text, watermark, or review panels. One subject only, full figure and complete rifle inside the canvas, subject at least 1300 pixels tall. This is a v5 EDIT attempt using only the two specified project references; do not use conversation images, staging images, or any other reference.
